\par\smallskip\raggedright
\textit{Note.} Statuses (not orderings): 'no estimator bounds position (EKF3 flags invalid; UKF and FGO diverge)' = the blank-floor status (ruling 2026-10-18; the blank floor is ruled 'not accuracy comparisons'); PASSED = met its pre-registered criteria with no comparison (Experiment 3, FGO only: H3.1--H3.4); N/A = not run. Ordering labels (BEST / BEHIND / TIED) are printed only where a pre-registered decision rule was met (ruling 2026-10-17); none is printed here.\par
\textit{Note.} Why no ordering label, by row (the footnote letters): standard sensors, H1.1 test run, rule not met [a], the UKF medians descriptive [b]; with the camera heading, C1.a registered with no decision rule [c]; blank floor, no comparative test [d]; Experiment 2 live, H2.3 FAIL [e]; Experiment 4 live, H4.2 FAIL [f] (H4.3, the FGO whole-flight batch within 1.5$\times$ of the smoothed UKF, PASSES [g], and H4.1, the batch below both filters' live tracks, PASSES (hindsight against live, not like with like); neither concerns the live key numbers); Experiment 3, one estimator [h]; Experiment 5, H5.2 / H5.3 / H5.4a--b FAIL on the final-build hold sets, identical to the original-build verdicts, all drift bands PASS [i]; closed loop, no comparative test registered, every set at half real-time (RTF 0.5) passes 3/3 [j].\par
\textit{Note.} Key numbers: 1A = cruise ATE, median of the 9 textured-floor flights of the standard-sensor dataset; 1B = the 6 textured-floor bags of the two camera datasets; Experiment 2 = horizontal RMSE with 1 tag; Experiment 4 = indoor RMSE; Experiment 3 = with loop closure; Experiment 5 = mean hold error; 1C = at half real-time (RTF 0.5). The simulator ran at half real time; the commanded flight speed was unchanged at 0.5 m/s. \textdagger{} runaway magnitude (order only). No cell restates a WITHDRAWN claim.\par
\textit{Note.} Ordering footnotes [a]--[j] (one per comparison; the letters in the experiment column): each footnote states the rule, the result and why no ordering label is printed. Ordering verdicts used in the footnotes: RULE MET = a pre-registered rule was applied and met, so its ordering (or similarity) is claimed; case (i) TEST RUN, RULE NOT MET = a pre-registered decision rule with a 'no ordering' outcome was applied and gave that outcome; case (ii) FAILED AS WORDED = a pre-registered prediction of an ordering or a similarity was scored literally and is false, which does not by itself establish the opposite ordering; case (iii) NO COMPARATIVE TEST REGISTERED = values are descriptive. n always names its unit (flights, bags, losses).\par
\textit{Note.} [a] Ordering basis, no heading, EKF3 against the FGO (H1.1, the confirmatory test). Metric: cruise ATE (SE(3)-aligned ATE over the pinned cruise window), m. n = 7 flights (flights 4--10 of the standard-sensor dataset: independent repeats of the same flight profile on the textured floor, every estimator on the same flights, paired); flight 10 has no FGO value, so it counts as 'not lower' in the sign count and the 95\% t-interval uses the 6 usable flights (df 5). Rule: claim 'EKF3 lower' (or, by the mirror rule, 'FGO lower') only if (a) the paired difference d = EKF3 $-$ FGO is negative on at least 6 of 7 flights AND (b) the 95\% t-interval of mean d excludes 0; otherwise no ordering is claimed (pre-registered, H1.1; METHODOLOGY.md:5650, METHODOLOGY.md:5652, METHODOLOGY.md:5653, METHODOLOGY.md:5654, METHODOLOGY.md:6237, METHODOLOGY.md:6239). Result: EKF3 lower on 5 of 7; mean d -0.021 m, 95\% CI -0.989 to +0.947 m (includes 0); (a) and (b) both fail. Verdict: case (i), TEST RUN, RULE NOT MET: no ordering is claimed.\par
\textit{Note.} [b] Ordering basis, no heading, the UKF against EKF3 and the FGO, and the medians over flights 1--9. Metric: cruise ATE (SE(3)-aligned ATE over the pinned cruise window), m. n = 9 flights (flights 1--9 of the standard-sensor dataset, textured floor; every estimator on the same flights). Rule: none: 'descriptive; no pre-registered UKF ordering test' (METHODOLOGY.md:7187); the medians over flights 1--9 are descriptive for all three, the confirmatory test being H1.1 on flights 4--10. Result: medians EKF3 4.10, UKF 5.13, FGO 4.46 m; the UKF highest on 6 of 9 flights. Verdict: case (iii), NO COMPARATIVE TEST REGISTERED: values are descriptive.\par
\textit{Note.} [c] Ordering basis, with the camera heading, the FGO against the UKF (C1.a). Metric: cruise ATE (SE(3)-aligned ATE over the pinned cruise window), m. n = 6 bags (textured floor, flights 1--3 of the textured-wall and of the plain-wall camera dataset; the UKF and the FGO replayed offline on the same bags, paired; on the 3 plain-wall bags the heading failed its validation, H1.2). Rule: none: C1.a was registered as 'REPORT, no decision rule' (METHODOLOGY.md:7892). Result: FGO lower on 6 of 6 bags (UKF 0.13--0.25 m, FGO 0.06--0.22 m). Verdict: case (iii), REGISTERED COMPARISON WITHOUT A DECISION RULE (C1.a was registered to be reported, with no decision rule): the ordering is descriptive, not tested.\par
\textit{Note.} [d] Ordering basis, blank floor (no flow aiding), all three estimators. Metric: error magnitude hypot(along, cross) after the flow-loss point, m, and EKF3's invalid period, s of cruise. n = 11 flights for the UKF and the FGO (both replayed on the same 11 blank-floor bags) and 14 flights for EKF3 (all blank-floor flights, Experiments 1A and 1B pooled). Rule: none: the blank floor is ruled 'Not accuracy comparisons' (METHODOLOGY.md:5551); no comparative test was pre-registered. Result: no estimator bounds position (UKF and FGO runaways, EKF3 position invalid), so no ordering is formed. Verdict: case (iii), NO COMPARATIVE TEST REGISTERED: values are descriptive.\par
\textit{Note.} [e] Ordering basis, Experiment 2 live tracks, EKF3, UKF and FGO (H2.3). Metric: horizontal RMSE over the 5 laps in the world frame, no alignment, mean of the flights in each condition, cm. n = 3 flights per condition, 4 conditions (12 flights; every estimator on the same flights, open loop on simulator truth, paired). Rule: H2.3 'live errors are similar': in every condition the largest live RMSE (mean over repeats) is $\le$ 1.5 $\times$ the smallest (METHODOLOGY.md:10178, METHODOLOGY.md:10179); no ordering test was registered, and the condition-D ordering is 'descriptive only (n = 3)' (METHODOLOGY.md:12803). Result: max $\div$ min 1.97 / 2.36 / 1.42 / 1.57 (conditions A / B / C / D): H2.3 FAILS (C inside the band); condition D: FGO 8.3, EKF3 9.6, UKF 13.1 cm, descriptive. Verdict: case (ii), FAILED AS WORDED: the registered prediction is false as written; a failed criterion does not by itself establish an ordering, so any ordering shown is descriptive.\par
\textit{Note.} [f] Ordering basis, Experiment 4 live tracks indoors, EKF3, UKF and FGO (H4.2). Metric: indoor horizontal RMSE in the world frame, no alignment, over the 123 s without GNSS, m. n = 3 flights (every estimator on the same flights, open loop on simulator truth, paired). Rule: H4.2 'live indoor errors are similar': in every flight the largest live indoor RMSE is $\le$ 1.5 $\times$ the smallest (METHODOLOGY.md:10360, METHODOLOGY.md:10361); no ordering test was registered. Result: max $\div$ min 1.71--1.84: H4.2 FAILS; EKF3 largest in 3 of 3 flights; UKF 0.77--0.84 m and FGO 0.83--0.89 m (both descriptive). Verdict: case (ii), FAILED AS WORDED: the registered prediction is false as written; a failed criterion does not by itself establish an ordering, so any ordering shown is descriptive.\par
\textit{Note.} [g] Ordering basis, Experiment 4, the FGO whole-flight batch against the smoothed UKF (H4.3). Metric: indoor horizontal RMSE in the world frame, no alignment, m. n = 3 flights (same flights, paired). Rule: H4.3: the two RMSEs within 1.5$\times$ of each other in every flight (METHODOLOGY.md:10362). Result: max $\div$ min 1.01--1.02: H4.3 PASSES; which is lower changes between flights (descriptive). Verdict: RULE MET: the similarity is claimed (no ordering).\par
\textit{Note.} [h] Ordering basis, Experiment 3, the keyframe FGO with against without loop closure (H3.1--H3.4; one estimator, not a comparison of estimators). Metric: horizontal RMSE in the first tag's frame, overall and per 6 m lap, m. n = 3 flights (each flight replayed with and without loop closure, paired). Rule: H3.2 'LC live overall RMSE $<$ no-LC live overall RMSE in 3/3 flights' (METHODOLOGY.md:10503); H3.3 the same for hindsight (METHODOLOGY.md:10504); H3.1 with loop closure lap 5 $\le$ 1.5 $\times$ lap 1 in 3/3 (METHODOLOGY.md:10501); H3.4 without, lap 5 $>$ 1.5 $\times$ lap 1 in 3/3 (METHODOLOGY.md:10505). Result: H3.1 / H3.2 / H3.3 / H3.4 pass on 3 / 3 / 3 / 3 of 3 flights (live 0.049--0.076 m with loop closure, 0.263--0.361 m without). Verdict: RULE MET: the ordering is claimed.\par
\textit{Note.} [i] Ordering basis, Experiment 5 comparative hypotheses, final-build sets (H5.2, H5.3, H5.4a, H5.4b). Metric: H5.2 mean hold error, mm; H5.3 hold gyro activity, max $\div$ min across the estimators; H5.4a/b re-lock jump after the 15 s / 5 s tag loss, mm. n = 3 flights per estimator (each estimator flew its own 3 flights, paired by run index, not trajectory; EKF3 = the EKF3-flying hold set at the far spawn). Rule: the pre-registered wording, verbatim: H5.2 'H-H2: the FGO's hold error is lowest. FGO $<$ EKF3 and FGO $<$ UKF mean hold error in 3/3 flights.' (tag\_hold\_design.md:180); H5.3 'P-H3 (smoothness, prediction): gyro activity in the hold windows within 1.5$\times$ across estimators.' (tag\_hold\_design.md:183); H5.4a, under 'H-H4 (tag loss)': 'After the 15 s occlusion, EKF3's re-lock jump (largest estimate step) is larger than the UKF's and the FGO's in 3/3 flights.' (tag\_hold\_design.md:185--186); H5.4b: 'After the 5 s occlusion (no timeout), the jumps are within 1.5$\times$ of each other.' (tag\_hold\_design.md:187) (design \S{}e, the only pre-registration of these four: they have no METHODOLOGY pre-registration line; \S{}e is unchanged since c11fcf3 (2026-10-08 15:17), before the first Experiment 5 flight; verdicts METHODOLOGY.md:12236, METHODOLOGY.md:13549). Result: FGO lowest in 0 of 3 flights (hold UKF 6.4--7.1, EKF3 7.8--7.9, FGO 8.3--8.6 mm; UKF lowest in 3 of 3); H5.3 max $\div$ min 2.40--2.58; H5.4a EKF3's 15 s jump 5 / 5 / 7 mm, the smallest; H5.4b max $\div$ min 3.2--7.7: all four FAIL. Verdict: case (ii), FAILED AS WORDED: the registered prediction is false as written; a failed criterion does not by itself establish an ordering, so any ordering shown is descriptive.\par
\textit{Note.} [j] Ordering basis, Experiment 1C closed loop, EKF3, final UKF port and final FGO node. Metric: without heading: wall-contact time after cruise start against each estimator's own contact window, s; with heading: pass/fail of the five closed-loop criteria and the estimator-validity criterion, with max $|$cross-track$|$ in cruise (m), heading error p95 and max (\textdegree{}) and max lateral speed (m/s). n = 1 flight per estimator without heading and 3 flights per estimator with heading (each estimator flew its own flights: separate, unpaired flights). Rule: per-estimator criteria only (H1.8 contact window and H1.9 the five criteria; METHODOLOGY.md:4948, METHODOLOGY.md:7513, METHODOLOGY.md:8995, METHODOLOGY.md:4951, METHODOLOGY.md:4966, METHODOLOGY.md:7362); no comparative test between the estimators was pre-registered, and the comparison across the with-heading sets is 'DESCRIPTIVE; separate flights, n = 3 each, no ordering claim' (METHODOLOGY.md:9355). Result: with heading 3/3 / 3/3 / 3/3 flights pass (EKF3 / UKF / FGO); max cross-track 0.24--0.33 / 0.22--0.25 / 0.03--0.39 m. Verdict: case (iii), NO COMPARATIVE TEST REGISTERED: values are descriptive.\par
